world_summary: A bounded archive reading-room world where roof-risk evidence, catalog-card timing, and visitor routing compete during a fixed rain archive event.

world_summary_i18n.zh-CN: 一个受约束的档案阅览室世界：屋顶风险证据、目录卡时机和访客动线在固定雨档案活动中相互牵制。

baseline_description: The baseline assumes the catalog cards arrive on time and the archive team can choose a dry reading-room route without extra injected disruption.

baseline_description_i18n.zh-CN: 基线假设目录卡按时到达，档案团队可以在没有额外扰动的情况下选择干燥的阅览室动线。

perturbation_options.title: Delay the catalog cards
perturbation_options.description: Delay the catalog-card tray before it reaches the reading-room handoff.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 让目录卡托盘在进入阅览室交接之前延迟。

perturbation_options.summary: Delay the catalog-card tray before it reaches the reading-room handoff.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 让目录卡托盘晚一点进入阅览室交接。

perturbation_options.title: Block the first route warning
perturbation_options.description: Block the first warning path from the visitor desk to the archive coordinator.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 阻断访客台发往档案协调人的第一条预警路径。

perturbation_options.summary: Block the first route warning toward the archive coordinator.

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 阻断发往档案协调人的第一条动线预警。

perturbation_options.title: Degrade the roof-watch window
perturbation_options.description: Create a short communication/resource failure while the north-roof risk is being assessed.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 在北侧屋顶风险评估期间制造一次短暂的通信/资源故障。

summary_i18n.zh-CN: 让北侧屋顶预警窗口变得更脆弱。
